title: The Deadly Mantis
description:
S1
A U.S. colonel (Craig Stevens) and a paleontologist (William Hopper) track a huge praying mantis from the North Pole to Manhattan.

title: Dr. Cyclops
description:
S1
A mad doctor (Albert Dekker) in Peru reduces a woman (Janice Logan) and three men to one-fifth their normal size.

title: Dracula
description:
S1
A real-estate man (Dwight Frye) visits the Transylvania castle of a 500-year-old vampire (Bela Lugosi).

title: Dracula
description:
S1
Van Helsing (Laurence Olivier) investigates as the vampire count (Frank Langella) scales walls and visits bedrooms at an English manor.

title: Dracula
description:
S1
This was made at night using the same sets and script as the Bela Lugosi classic but with a Spanish cast.

title: Dracula's Daughter
description:
S1
A vampire countess (Gloria Holden) in black falls in love with a psychologist (Otto Kruger) and kidnaps his fiancée (Marguerite Churchill).

title: The Evil of Frankenstein
description:
S1
The baron (Peter Cushing) and a hypnotist (Peter Woodthorpe) bring the creature out of ice, horrifying villagers of Karlsbad.

title: Frankenstein
description:
S1
Baron Frankenstein creates a monster from cadavers and a killer's brain.

title: Frankenstein Meets the Wolfman
description:
S1
Tormented werewolf Larry Talbot (Lon Chaney Jr.) calls on Dr. Frankenstein and finds his monster (Bela Lugosi) instead.

title: The Frozen Ghost
description:
S1
When famous radio hypnotist Alex Gregor (Lon Chaney Jr.) accidentally causes the death of an audience member during a broadcast, his guilt leads him to break off his engagement to Maura Daniel (Evelyn Ankers) and take a job at a wax museum.

title: The Funhouse
description:
S1
Naughty teens (Elizabeth Berridge, Cooper Huckabee, Miles Chapin) are locked in a carnival fun house with a man in a Frankenstein mask.
